name: Document Readiness Dashboard
query:
SELECT
  eo.name AS `Export Order`,
  eo.buyer_country AS `Buyer Country`,
  eo.estimated_ship_date AS `Estimated Ship Date`,
  eo.certificate_of_origin_status AS `COO Status`,
  CASE
    WHEN eo.certificate_of_origin_status != 'Issued' AND eo.estimated_ship_date IS NOT NULL
         AND DATEDIFF(eo.estimated_ship_date, CURDATE()) <= 3
    THEN '⚠ Missing Documents'
    ELSE 'OK'
  END AS `Readiness Flag`,
  IFNULL(eo.total_cbm, 0) AS `Total CBM`,
  eo.container_estimate AS `Container Estimate`
FROM `tabExport Order` eo
WHERE eo.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY eo.estimated_ship_date ASC
